utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive this Saturday at the community shed at 10—come by if you can, and send anyone handy my way too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m coming in late again, Quinn, but I’m pretty sure Vik said it’s at the community center at nine, not the shed at ten.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks for the heads-up—I’ve been telling folks it’s the community shed at 10, so I’m going to double-check right away and keep spreading the word once I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Nell, I’m not counting on a time yet—please check with Opal and confirm whether the repair drive starts at nine or ten at the community center lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’d trust Rosa or Opal on the official time—but Gus said he’ll be at the community center lot by 9 to set up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: All right, then I’m still waiting on Opal to settle it officially—let’s plan on the community center lot, but I won’t count the start time until she confirms nine or ten.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Kira, I’m on for Saturday 9:30 to 1:30 around school drop-off and pickup, and I heard we still need extension cords, work gloves, and lamp parts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s actually bringing those extension cords, gloves, and lamp parts, and whether they’re being stored at the repair drive table once they arrive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I only know Cleo said we’re still short on extension cords, work gloves, and lamp parts—I haven’t heard who’s bringing them yet, so I’d check with Cleo or Leo about where they’ll be stored.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Cleo, I think it’s the community center at nine, but I’d rather double-check with Quinn so I don’t send anyone to the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good call—while you check with Quinn, I’ll keep updating the supply list so we know if we still need more extension cords or work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo—I’ll ask Quinn now and let you know the meeting spot as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still interested, Vik, but before I commit I need the full tool list and a confirmed storage spot so this doesn’t get messy.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right now I’m telling everyone it’s Saturday at 10 at the community garden lot, and Rey said the tools can go there too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that helps, but I still need Rey to confirm exactly who’s bringing which tools before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hana, last I heard they’re still aiming for Saturday morning around 10-ish at the community center lot, though it’s not totally locked in yet. Folks are sounding ready, and I’ll pass along anything firmer as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess—before I note that down, can you confirm we’re still prioritizing only safety-related repairs like space heaters and lamps for this first pass?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Far as I’ve heard, yes—it’s still the safety repairs first, like heaters and lamps, for this first round; if that shifts when they compare lists, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, how many people are actually on the sign-up right now?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh gosh, I should’ve counted before I started talking about everything else—I don’t want to guess, but I can check the sign-up sheet and tell you in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Please check it now and give me the exact count—I need that before I decide on cords and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Last I heard it’s Saturday around 9 by the community center lot, but Rosa’s the one with the real details—just tell me what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That matches what I’ve got so far—bring basic tools and work gloves, and we’re putting safety repairs first, like heaters, lamps, cords, and anything urgent. I’ll confirm the full tool list once I lock down the storage spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’ll bring my toolkit and work gloves, plus a few extra cords if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive pinned to Sunday at 10 at the community center lot—are you still meeting us there, Jules?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, I’m in—I’ve been shaping around Faye’s 9:30 to 1:30 window, so Sunday at 10 at the community center lot works well on my end.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—I’ve got you down for Sunday at 10 at the community center lot, and I’ll keep the drop-off notes lined up from there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rosa, Gus is bringing everything to the repair drive table around 9, and I’ll line it up there when he arrives.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo—that helps a lot. Just note the update: the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so let’s have Gus bring everything there around 9.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I’ll update it to Sunday at the community center and have Gus bring everything there around 9.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring a little for the repair drive on Sunday at the community center—things are a bit tight for me right now, but I do want to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli—that still helps a lot. We’re planning for around 10-ish at the community center, and once Cleo confirms what supplies are still missing, I can pass along the list so you can choose something small.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey—I’d appreciate that. If you send the list, I’ll bring what small thing I can on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like it’s shaping up well—if 10 still holds, I’ll stop by after errands and help wherever I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Ira—I’ll be at the repair drive table by 9 with the drill, ladders, and stud finder, so come by at 10 and we’ll plug you in where help’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll aim for 10 once I’m done with errands and check in at your table first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there by 9 with the drill and ladders, and I’ll check in at the repair drive table right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Gus—I’ve been telling everyone we’re meeting at the community center at nine, so I’ll keep repeating that and let folks know you’re bringing the drill and ladders.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Vik—I’ll head straight to the repair drive table at 9 with the drill and ladders.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m waiting on Cleo’s final tool list and storage details, but it still sounds like around 10-ish this weekend. Once I have the specifics, I’ll pass them along so people can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—before I note that, can you confirm whether that 10-ish is just online sign-ups, and whether we’re still prioritizing safety-related repairs like space heaters and lamps for this first pass?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that 10-ish is just the tentative start for the repair drive itself, not online sign-ups, and from what Cleo shared we’re mostly still focusing on the safer small fixes first, like lamps, while she finishes the final list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes—Gus is bringing everything to the repair drive table around 9, and I’ll get it lined up and stored there once he arrives.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo—thank you; let’s keep the space heaters and lamps front and center, and tomorrow I’ll compare our list with Jules’s so we can lock the rest in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I'll keep the space heaters and lamps up front, and we can lock the rest in after you compare lists tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m sorting the donated tools now and setting aside anything missing parts; once Leo confirms the storage spot, I can share the full tool list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late jumping in, Sam, but I do remember Vik saying the repair drive’s at the community center at nine. Once Leo confirms storage, send the list over and I’ll catch up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane—that helps; I’m still sorting the donated tools now, and I’ll send the full list over as soon as Leo confirms the storage spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m trying to shape it around Faye’s 9:30 to 1:30 window, with Rosa kicking things off Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot—if you’re in, what timing works for you?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before I say I’m in, can you confirm that timing for sure? Rosa told me Saturday starts at 9, and I still need a clear answer on who’s bringing the tools and where they’re being stored.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d go with Rosa’s latest: Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot, and I’m planning around that unless she says otherwise. I know the toolkit and cords are coming, but I’m checking now on exactly who’s storing and bringing everything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, 10-ish at the community center lot works for me—just ping me if Rosa changes anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—I’ve got you down for 10-ish at the community center lot, and I’ll update you if Rosa gives us a firmer time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just holler if she wants me to bring anything besides the usual tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nell, last I heard they’re still aiming for Saturday morning for the repair drive, though Marcy said it could slide a little, and folks still seem ready to come out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’d heard in bits and pieces—Rosa’s organizing it, right? I thought it was Saturday around 10, but if Marcy says it might slide, I’d love to know the latest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s what I’ve heard too—Saturday morning, around 10 if it holds, with Rosa organizing and Marcy still leaving a little wiggle room. If I hear anything firmer, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, how many people have actually signed up for the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard a headcount yet—just that Jules is pulling folks in from a few different circles and aiming for a late-morning start.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay—can you check with Jules and get me an actual count, plus how many can arrive by 9?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive this Saturday at the community shed starting at 10—come by if you can, and bring anyone else who’d want to help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—thanks, Quinn. I thought we were starting at nine, but I may’ve muddled that, so I’d better double-check before I repeat it around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, it’s 10 at the community shed on Saturday, so please pass that along if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks again, Uli—that means a lot. I’ll look for you Sunday at the community center, and whatever you can bring will be a real help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course, Rosa. I’ll be there Sunday with a little, and I’m glad it’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Uli—that’s a big help, and I really appreciate you rolling with the change. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still set for Saturday 9:30 to 1:30, if that helps the repair drive planning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That helps, Faye; I’m still waiting on a clear start time, but if it’s in that window I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—if you hear the start time lands in that window, count me in, since I’m working around school drop-off and pickup.
